push.title: W 4-2 vs viscabarca28 | You: 9.0
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 9.0. You played like someone who read the playbook twice and highlighted it.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at viscabarca28's goal. You were hungry in front of goal, and I love a hungry striker.
+ 1 key pass. That's the kind of creativity that keeps opposing coaches up at night.
+ Man of the Match, your 9th for us. When you play like that, the whole team stands taller.
+ Tackles attempted 6, up from your usual 2. That's growth you can count.
+ BellyTb1 finished what you started. That's teamwork.

THE BAD
- Missed tackles 5, up from your usual 1. Old coach's advice: Show them down the line, toward the touchline and away from goal, then strike.
- Giveaways 11, up from your usual 6. That's not a crisis, but it's a warning light.
- Shots on target: 67%. Halfway to the summit; the peak is 90%+.

Backyard drill: Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.

Hey PhogsToffees, hold onto this one: If you're gonna make a mistake, make it at full speed and learn it at half.

What a joy. What a game. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-2 vs viscabarca28 | You: 7.9
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, a 7.9. You were reliable as a porch light, and that matters more than you know.

THE GOOD
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). That's playmaking, plain and simple.
+ Feeding PhogsToffees like that is a recipe I want to keep making.
+ Completed passes 14, up from your usual 8. Keep stacking those bricks.
+ 0.4 above average. Growth looks good on you.
+ Stayed on and finished the match after buddskees walked off. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.

THE BAD
- Won 0 of 3 tackles (down from your usual 27%). Real quick: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away. Simple as Sunday.
- 67% passing (14 of 21, up from your usual 55%). Tiny tweak: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
- tackle timing showed up for you and BellyTb1. Talk it through and one presses, one covers.
- Shots on target 0, down from your usual 2. Coach's tip: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

Drill: Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.

tuxedo_slide, write this on your hand if you have to: The comeback is always more fun than the setback.

We'll get there together. - Coach Lasso
